### Loading packages and preparing data.
```{r, message=F, warning=F}
# Load packages.
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
library(vegan)
library(nlme)
library(ggpubr)
library(kableExtra)
library(broom)

library(car)
library(tableone)
library(extrafont)
library(openxlsx)
library(factoextra)
library(cluster)
library(Rtsne)
library(ggrepel)
library(FactoMineR)
library(mixOmics)
library(dbscan)
library(energy)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpubr)
library(Boruta)
library(pls)
library(pROC)
library(kernlab)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(e1071)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(here)

# Load metadatas and join.
metadata1 <- fread(here("data", "metadata_serum_metabolomics.csv")) %>%
    dplyr::select(lbnr, SampleName)
metadata2 <- fread(here("data", "metadata_serum_metabolomics_cleaned.csv")) %>%
    dplyr::select(diagnosis_phase,SampleName,SampleAge,final_diag,sex,YearsBetween,age_at_sampling) %>%
    left_join(y = metadata1, by = "SampleName")  

# Load raw metabolite data.    
raw <- fread(here("data", "ft_all_quant_blankrm_imp_rsdremoved_waveica_ms2_20240815_log.csv")) %>%
    filter(SampleName %in% metadata2$SampleName) %>%
    dplyr::select(-V1) %>%
    as_tibble() 

# Load severity information for CD and UC.  
cd_severity_metadata = fread(here("data", "cd_severity_metadata.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(lbnr, severity) %>%
  mutate(severity = case_when(severity %in% c("Mild","Moderate") ~ "Non-Severe", severity == "Severe" ~ "Severe"))
uc_severity_metadata = fread(here("data", "uc_severity_metadata.csv")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(lbnr, severity) %>%
  mutate(severity = case_when(severity %in% c("Mild", "Moderate") ~ "Non-Severe", severity == "Severe" ~ "Severe"))
severity_metadata = bind_rows(cd_severity_metadata, uc_severity_metadata)

# Join raw data and metadata.
data <- metadata2 %>% 
  left_join(raw, by = "SampleName") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(batch)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("SampleName") %>% 
  rename_with(~paste0("X", .x), .cols = matches("^\\d")) %>% 
  mutate_all(~ replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
  left_join(y = severity_metadata, by = "lbnr")

# Rearrange dataset and scale.
raw1 <- data[, c(1:7, 4907, 8:2917)]
raw1 <- scale(raw1[, 9:2918])
raw1[raw1>5] <- 5
raw1[raw1< -5] <- -5
raw2 = cbind.data.frame(data[, c(1:7,4907)], raw1)
raw2 = as.data.frame(raw2) %>% 
  mutate(final_diag = case_when(str_starts(final_diag, "UC") ~ "UC",
                              str_starts(final_diag, "CD") ~ "CD",
                              T ~ final_diag))

# Filter for patients existing in both metadatas
cd_patients = raw2 %>%
  filter(final_diag == "CD")
uc_patients = raw2 %>%
  filter(final_diag == "UC")
raw2 = raw2 %>%
  filter(lbnr %in% c(cd_severity_metadata$lbnr, uc_severity_metadata$lbnr))

# Filter for the "Around Diagnosis" timepoint
raw2_around_diag = raw2 %>%
  filter(diagnosis_phase == "AroundDiagnosis2Y") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "lbnr")

# Load main annotations
annotations <- readxl::read_excel(here("data", "prediag_ibd_serum_annotations_250211.xlsx")) %>%
    dplyr::select("Metabolite ID","Annotation", "Metabolite class") %>%
    rename("MetID" = "Metabolite ID") %>%
    mutate(MetID = paste0("X", MetID))

# Define annotation update function
update_annotations <- function(main_df, file_path, metid_col = 1, annot_col, class_col) {
    fread(file_path) %>%
        dplyr::select(all_of(c(metid_col, annot_col, class_col))) %>%
        rename("Annotation" = !!names(.)[2], "Metabolite class" = !!names(.)[3]) %>%
        mutate(
            MetID = paste0("X", .data[[names(.)[1]]]),
            across(where(is.character), ~ {
                case_when(is.na(.) | . %in% c("0", "#N/A", "") ~ NA_character_, TRUE ~ .)
            }),
            across(where(is.numeric), ~ {
                case_when(is.na(.) | . == 0 ~ NA_real_, TRUE ~ .)
            })
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(MetID, Annotation, `Metabolite class`) %>%
        group_by(MetID) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1) %>%
        ungroup()
}

# Apply updates sequentially
annotations <- rows_patch(annotations, update_annotations(annotations, here("new_annotations_23.02.csv"), 1, 2, 3), by = "MetID", unmatched = "ignore")
annotations <- rows_patch(annotations, update_annotations(annotations, here("Metabolites_sig_clusters.csv"), 1, 11, 8), by = "MetID", unmatched = "ignore")

# Cohort Characteristics
patient_demo_around_diag <- raw2_around_diag %>%
    group_by(final_diag) %>%
    summarise(
        med_age           = median(SampleAge, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_age            = sd(SampleAge, na.rm = TRUE),
        med_agesampling   = median(age_at_sampling, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_agesampling    = sd(age_at_sampling, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_males           = sum(sex == "Male", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_females         = sum(sex == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_total           = n(),
        n_severe          = sum(severity == "Severe", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_non_severe      = sum(severity == "Non-Severe", na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        age_diag = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", med_age, sd_age),
        age_sampling = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", med_agesampling, sd_agesampling)
    ) %>%
    rename(IBD_subtype = final_diag) %>%
   dplyr::select(1, 6:12)
patient_demo_around_diag
```

### Metabolite clustering 
``` {r, message=F,warning=F} 

# Use stable UMAP coordinates and plot.
umap_raw5 = fread(here("data", "umap_coord_seed5.csv")) 
names(umap_raw5) = make.unique(names(umap_raw5))
umap_raw5 = umap_raw5 %>%
  rename("MetID" = "V1",
         "V1" = "V1.1")

# Plot metabolite UMAP:
umap_plot3 <- ggplot(umap_raw5, aes(V1, V2)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.2, ,colour = "#FF906D") +
    labs(x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) + 
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")
umap_plot3

# Run HDBSCAN unsupervised clustering (minimum cluster size = 10 metabolites).
metabolite_hdb = hdbscan(umap_raw5[, c(2,3)], minPts = 10)

# Filter for non-null membership strength.
metabolite_clusters = umap_raw5 %>%
  filter(!membership_strength == 0)

# Declare data frame for cluster validation.
cluster_ids = unique(metabolite_clusters$hdbscan_cluster)
intra_cluster_distances = data.frame(hdbscan_cluster = cluster_ids,
                                      mean_correl = NA_real_,
                                     correl_z = NA)   

set.seed(5)
n_random = 1000   

# Run loop: compute correlation between clusters and compare with random sets.
for (i in seq_along(cluster_ids)) {
  
  cid = cluster_ids[i]
  
  met_in_cluster = metabolite_clusters$MetID[metabolite_clusters$hdbscan_cluster == cid]
  k = length(met_in_cluster)
  
  mat = raw4[met_in_cluster, , drop = F]
  
  cor_mat = cor(t(mat))
  dist_cor = 1 - cor_mat
  mean_correl = mean(dist_cor[upper.tri(dist_cor)])
  
  # Randomization to compare
  rand_cor = replicate(n_random, {
    rand_mets = sample(rownames(raw4), k)
    cor_r = cor(t(raw4[rand_mets, , drop = F]))
    mean(1 - cor_r[upper.tri(cor_r)])
  })  
  
  # Compute Z-score equivalents.
  intra_cluster_distances$mean_correl[i] = mean_correl
  intra_cluster_distances$correl_z[i] = (mean_correl - mean(rand_cor)) / sd(rand_cor)
    
}

# Pull all clusters
selected_clusters = intra_cluster_distances %>%
  pull(hdbscan_cluster)
selected_metabolites = metabolite_clusters %>% 
  filter(hdbscan_cluster %in% selected_clusters) %>%
  dplyr::select(1, 4,5)

# Compute cluster score per sample by using membership strengths as weights:
cluster_ids = sort(unique(selected_metabolites$hdbscan_cluster))
module_scores = matrix(NA, nrow = length(cluster_ids), ncol = ncol(raw4))
rownames(module_scores) = paste0("Cluster_", cluster_ids)
colnames(module_scores) = colnames(raw4)

for (cid in cluster_ids) {
  
  cluster_mets = metabolite_clusters %>%
    filter(hdbscan_cluster == cid)
  
  m_ids = cluster_mets$MetID
  weights = cluster_mets$membership_strength
  mat = raw4[m_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  
  weighted_scores = apply(mat, 2, function(x)
    sum(x * weights) / sum(weights))
  
  module_scores[paste0("Cluster_", cid), ] = weighted_scores
}

raw5_cluster_scores = as.data.frame(module_scores)

# Prepare data frames for modelling: fresh metadata, fresh cluster scores data frame containing "severity" column.
metadata3 = raw2_around_diag[, c(1:7)] %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "lbnr")
raw6_severity = as.data.frame(t(raw5_cluster_scores)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "lbnr")
metadata_for_raw6 = metadata3[, c("final_diag", "lbnr")] 
raw6_severity = left_join(x = raw6_severity, y = metadata_for_raw6, by = "lbnr")

# Actual data frames for modelling: X and y (for both CD and UC)
raw6_severity = left_join(x = raw6_severity, y = severity_metadata %>% mutate(lbnr = as.character(lbnr)), by = "lbnr") 

cd_logistic = raw6_severity %>%
  filter(final_diag == "CD") %>%
  mutate(severity_bin = ifelse(severity == "Severe", 1, 0))
cluster_cols_cd_logistic = grep("^Cluster", colnames(cd_logistic), value = T)
X_cd = scale(as.matrix(cd_logistic[, cluster_cols_cd_logistic]))
y_cd = cd_logistic$severity_bin

uc_logistic = raw6_severity %>%
  filter(final_diag == "UC") %>%
  mutate(severity_bin = ifelse(severity == "Severe", 1, 0))
cluster_cols_uc_logistic = grep("^Cluster", colnames(uc_logistic), value = T)
X_uc = scale(as.matrix(uc_logistic[, cluster_cols_uc_logistic]))
y_uc = uc_logistic$severity_bin

# Perform Boruta here and store results for subsequent validation.

# Boruta on CD and UC 
boruta_clusters_cd = as.data.frame(t(raw5_cluster_scores)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("lbnr") %>%
  mutate(lbnr = as.integer(lbnr)) %>%
  left_join(y = as.data.frame(cd_severity_metadata), by = "lbnr") %>%
  column_to_rownames("lbnr") %>%
  drop_na()
boruta_clusters_uc = as.data.frame(t(raw5_cluster_scores)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("lbnr") %>%
  mutate(lbnr = as.integer(lbnr)) %>%
  left_join(y = as.data.frame(uc_severity_metadata), by = "lbnr") %>%
  column_to_rownames("lbnr") %>%
  drop_na()

boruta_clusters_cd$severity = factor(boruta_clusters_cd$severity)
boruta_clusters_uc$severity = factor(boruta_clusters_uc$severity)

# Run algorithm with 500 runs and fix uncertain clusters.
set.seed(1000)
boruta_clusters_cd_res = Boruta(severity ~ ., data = boruta_clusters_cd, doTrace = 1, maxRuns = 500)
boruta_clusters_uc_res = Boruta(severity ~ ., data = boruta_clusters_uc, doTrace = 1, maxRuns = 500)

boruta_clusters_cd_res_final <- TentativeRoughFix(boruta_clusters_cd_res)
boruta_clusters_cd_res_final_confirmed_mets <- getSelectedAttributes(boruta_clusters_cd_res_final)

boruta_clusters_uc_res_final <- TentativeRoughFix(boruta_clusters_uc_res)
boruta_clusters_uc_res_final_confirmed_mets <- getSelectedAttributes(boruta_clusters_uc_res_final)

boruta_clusters_cd_res_final_confirmed_mets
boruta_clusters_uc_res_final_confirmed_mets
```

### Performing correlations between clusters and metadata variables.
```{r, message=F,warning=F}
# Correlation with metadata
raw7 = as.data.frame(t(raw5_cluster_scores)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("lbnr")
metadata4 = raw2_around_diag[, c(1:7)] %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "lbnr")
merged_raw7_metadata = inner_join(metadata4, raw7, by = "lbnr")

# Correlation with continuous variables (Sample Age, Age at Diagnosis, Years Between Sampling and Diagnosis):

numeric_meta = merged_raw7_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))
cor_mat_cont = cor(numeric_meta, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
cluster_vars = grep("^Cluster", colnames(cor_mat_cont), value = T)
meta_vars = setdiff(colnames(cor_mat_cont), cluster_vars)

cor_df = as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat_cont[meta_vars, cluster_vars]))
colnames(cor_df) = c("metadata", "cluster", "correlation")

# Assign p-values
p_mat = matrix(NA, nrow = length(meta_vars), ncol = length(cluster_vars),
               dimnames = list(meta_vars, cluster_vars))
for (i in seq_along(meta_vars)) {  # Fixed: use i not m twice
    m <- meta_vars[i]
    for (c in cluster_vars) {
        test <- cor.test(merged_raw7_metadata[[m]], merged_raw7_metadata[[c]], method = "spearman")
        p_mat[m, c] <- test$p.value
    }
}

# Adjust p-values per metadata variable
p_df = as.data.frame(as.table(p_mat))
colnames(p_df) = c("metadata", "cluster", "p_value")
cor_df = merge(cor_df, p_df, by = c("metadata", "cluster")) %>%
  group_by(metadata) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Correlation with categorical variables (Time-to-Diagnosis, Sex, Disease Subtype):

# Declare new column based on time between sampling and diagnosis:
raw7 <- raw7 %>%
  left_join(metadata3, by = "lbnr") %>%
  mutate(
    time_to_diag = case_when(
      YearsBetween < 0 ~ "before",
      YearsBetween == 0 ~ "diag",
      YearsBetween > 0 ~ "after",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Perform Kruskal-Wallis (for 3 groups) and adjust p-values:
kruskal_results_clusterscores_yearsdiag <- map_dfr(
  colnames(raw7[, -c(1, 62:69)]),
  function(v) {
    test <- kruskal.test(raw7[[v]] ~ raw7$time_to_diag)
    data.frame(
      variable = v,
      H_statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )}) %>%
  mutate(
  metadata_var = "time_to_diag",
  p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"))
# No significant associations between cluster scores and time-to-diag after adjustment.

# For sex use Kruskal-Wallis:
kruskal_results_clusterscores_sex <- map_dfr(colnames(raw7[, -1]), function(c) {
    test <- kruskal.test(raw7[[c]] ~ metadata4$sex)
    data.frame(
        variable = c,
        H_statistic = test$statistic,  # Kruskal-Wallis H (like F)
        p_value = test$p.value
    )})
# Adjust p-values:
kruskal_results_clusterscores_sex$metadata_var <- "sex"
rownames(kruskal_results_clusterscores_sex) = NULL
kruskal_results_clusterscores_sex = kruskal_results_clusterscores_sex %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, "fdr"))

# For diagnosis use Kruskal-Wallis:
kruskal_results_clusterscores_finaldiag <- map_dfr(colnames(raw7[, -1]), function(c) {
    test <- kruskal.test(raw7[[c]] ~ metadata4$final_diag)
    data.frame(
        variable = c,
        H_statistic = test$statistic,
        p_value = test$p.value
    )})

# Adjust p-values:
kruskal_results_clusterscores_finaldiag$metadata_var <- "final_diag"
rownames(kruskal_results_clusterscores_finaldiag) = NULL
kruskal_results_clusterscores_finaldiag = kruskal_results_clusterscores_finaldiag %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, "fdr"))

# Extract only significant correlations:

cor_df_sign = cor_df %>%
  filter(p_adj <= 0.05)
kruskal_results_clusterscores_finaldiag_sign = kruskal_results_clusterscores_finaldiag %>%
  filter(p_adj <= 0.05)
```

### Models 1 and 2: Sparse PLS-DA and Kernel PLS-DA.
``` {r, message=F,warning=F} 
# CD #

# First, Sparse PLS-DA
y_cd = factor(cd_logistic$severity_bin, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Non-Severe", "Severe"))
set.seed(842)
shared_folds_cd = sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(y_cd)))

# 2 components, keepX (important features) grid, 5-fold cross-validation with 10 repeats:
set.seed(842)
ncomp = 2
keepX_grid = c(5,10,15,20)
nfolds = 5
nrepeat = 10

cv_results_cd = list()
cluster_stability_cd = list()
metrics_results_cd = list()

# Run loop: go through keepX values, train sPLS-DA on training set and predict on test set.
for (keepX_val in keepX_grid) {

  error_fold = c()
  y_true_all = c()
  y_prob_all = c()
  y_pred_all = c()

  selected_by_comp = vector("list", ncomp)
  names(selected_by_comp) = paste0("comp", 1:ncomp)

  for (rep in 1:nrepeat) {

    folds = shared_folds_cd

    for (k in 1:nfolds) {

      train_idx = which(folds != k)
      test_idx = which(folds == k)

      X_train = X_cd[train_idx,]
      y_train = y_cd[train_idx]
      X_test = X_cd[test_idx,]
      y_test = y_cd[test_idx]

      plsda_fit = mixOmics::splsda(X_train, y_train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = rep(keepX_val, ncomp))
      pred = predict(plsda_fit, X_test)
      y_pred = pred$class$max.dist[, ncomp]

      # Posterior probability for "Severe"
      prob_mat = pred$predict[, , ncomp]
      prob_severe = prob_mat[, "Severe"]
      
      error_fold = c(error_fold, mean(y_pred != y_test))

      # store out-of-fold truth and predictions
      y_true_all = c(y_true_all, as.character(y_test))
      y_prob_all = c(y_prob_all, prob_severe)
      y_pred_all = c(y_pred_all, as.character(y_pred))
      
      # track variable selection
      for (comp in 1:ncomp) {
        vars_comp = mixOmics::selectVar(plsda_fit, comp = comp)$name
        selected_by_comp[[comp]] = c(selected_by_comp[[comp]], vars_comp)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Compute performance metrics on true and predicted probabilities:
  mean_error = mean(error_fold)
  accuracy = 1 - mean_error
  
  y_true_fac = factor(y_true_all, levels = c("Non-Severe", "Severe"))
  y_pred_fac = factor(y_pred_all, levels = c("Non-Severe", "Severe"))
  
  cm = table(Truth = y_true_fac, Pred = y_pred_fac)
  
  sens_severe = cm["Severe","Severe"] / sum(cm["Severe", ])
  spec_severe = cm["Non-Severe", "Non-Severe"] / sum(cm["Non-Severe", ])
  bal_acc = (sens_severe + spec_severe) / 2
  
  roc_obj = roc(y_true_fac, y_prob_all,
                levels = c("Non-Severe", "Severe"))
  auc_val = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  
  y_bin = ifelse(y_true_fac == "Severe", 1, 0)
  brier = mean((y_prob_all - y_bin)^2)
  rmse = sqrt(mean((y_prob_all - y_bin)^2))
  
  auc_ci_boot = ci.auc(roc_obj, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = 2000)
  
  # Aggregate metrics:
  cv_results_cd[[paste0("keepX_", keepX_val)]] = mean_error
  cluster_stability_cd[[paste0("keepX_", keepX_val)]] = lapply(selected_by_comp, table)
  metrics_results_cd[[paste0("keepX", keepX_val)]] = list(
    mean_error = mean_error,
    accuracy = accuracy,
    bal_acc = bal_acc,
    auc = auc_val,
    auc_ci = auc_ci_boot,
    brier = brier,
    rmse = rmse,
    confusion_matrix = cm
  )
}

# Store top 10 (best keepX value) important clusters (features):
spls_fit_cd = mixOmics::splsda(X = X_cd, Y = y_cd, ncomp = 2, keepX = c(10,10))
loadings_comp1_cd = abs(spls_fit_cd$loadings$X[, 1])[spls_fit_cd$loadings$X[, 1] != 0]
imp_scores_splsda_cd = data.frame(cluster = names(loadings_comp1_cd), importance = loadings_comp1_cd, row.names = NULL)
direction_splsda_cd = spls_fit_cd$loadings$X[, 1][spls_fit_cd$loadings$X[, 1] != 0]

metrics_results_splsda = metrics_results_cd$keepX10
# Extract confusion matrix
cm <- metrics_results_splsda$confusion_matrix
cm_result_splsda = confusionMatrix(cm) 
cm_table <- as.data.frame(cm_result_splsda$table)

# Second, Kernel PLS-DA
X = as.matrix(X_cd)
y = factor(y_cd, levels = c("Non-Severe", "Severe"))

# Compute radial basis function kernel matrix:
rbf_kernel_cd = function(X_train, X_test = NULL, gamma) {

  if(is.null(X_test)){
    K=as.matrix(kernelMatrix(rbfdot(sigma = gamma), X_train))

  } else {
    K = as.matrix(kernelMatrix(rbfdot(sigma = gamma), X_test, X_train))
  }
  return(K)
}

# 2 components, relatively small gamma for kernel to decay slowly:
set.seed(842)
n = nrow(X)
ncomp = 2
gamma = 0.01
nfolds = 5
nrepeat = 10

# Declare variables for predicted probability storage:
oof_prob_cd = rep(NA_real_, n)
oof_class_cd = rep(NA_character_, n)
oof_scores_cd = matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = ncomp)

# Run loop fitting PLSR on the training-similarity matrix.
for (rep_i in 1:nrepeat) {
    folds = shared_folds_cd

    for (fold in 1:nfolds) {

      train_idx = which(folds != fold)
      test_idx = which(folds == fold)

      X_train = X[train_idx, , drop = F]
      y_train = ifelse(y[train_idx] == "Severe", 1, 0)
      X_test = X[test_idx, ,drop = F]

      K_train = rbf_kernel_cd(X_train, X_train, gamma = gamma)
      K_test = rbf_kernel_cd(X_train, X_test, gamma = gamma)

      pls_fit = plsr(y_train ~ K_train, ncomp = ncomp, scale = T, validation = "none", method = "oscorespls")

      # Predicted values for test set
      yhat_test = as.numeric(predict(pls_fit, K_test, ncomp = ncomp))

      oof_prob_cd[test_idx] = yhat_test
      oof_class_cd[test_idx] = ifelse(yhat_test > 0.5, "Severe", "Non-Severe")

      # Component scores for test samples
      test_scores = scores(pls_fit)
      oof_scores_cd[test_idx, ] = predict(pls_fit, newdata = K_test, type = "scores", ncomp = ncomp)
    }
  }

# Performance metrics using predictions:
y_true_cd = y
y_pred = factor(oof_class_cd, levels = c("Non-Severe", "Severe"))
error_val = mean(y_pred != y_true_cd)
accuracy = 1 - error_val
cm = table(Truth = y_true_cd, Pred = y_pred)

sens_severe = cm["Severe","Severe"] / sum(cm["Severe", ])
spec_severe = cm["Non-Severe", "Non-Severe"] / sum(cm["Non-Severe", ])
bal_acc = (sens_severe + spec_severe) / 2

roc_obj = roc(y_true_cd, oof_prob_cd,
                levels = c("Non-Severe", "Severe"))
auc_val = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
auc_ci_boot = ci.auc(roc_obj, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = 2000)

y_bin = ifelse(y_true_cd == "Severe", 1, 0)
brier = mean((oof_prob_cd - y_bin)^2)
rmse = sqrt(mean((oof_prob_cd- y_bin)^2))

# Aggregate metrics:
perf_kernel_plsda_cd = list(
    mean_error = mean_error,
    accuracy = accuracy,
    bal_acc = bal_acc,
    auc = auc_val,
    auc_ci = auc_ci_boot,
    brier = brier,
    rmse = rmse,
    confusion_matrix = cm
  )

# Permutation importance for each cluster, measuring AUC drops per shuffle:
y_true_num_cd = as.numeric(y_true_cd == "Severe")
baseline_auc_kernel_plsda_cd = as.numeric(auc_val)

kernel_cd_perm_imp = function(col_name) {
  X_perm = X_cd
  X_perm[, col_name] = sample(X_perm[, col_name])

  oof_prob_perm = rep(NA_real_, nrow(X_perm))

  for (rep in 1:10) {
    folds = shared_folds_cd

    for (fold in 1:5) {
      train_idx = which(folds != fold)
      test_idx = which(folds == fold)

      X_train = X_perm[train_idx, , drop = F]
      y_train_num = as.numeric(y_true_cd[train_idx] == "Severe")
      X_test = X_perm[test_idx, , drop = F]

      K_train = rbf_kernel_cd(X_train, NULL, gamma = 0.01)
      K_test = rbf_kernel_cd(X_train, X_test, gamma = 0.01)

      pls_fit = plsr(y_train_num ~ K_train, ncomp = 2, scale = T)

      yhat_test = as.numeric(predict(pls_fit, K_test, ncomp = 2))
      oof_prob_perm[test_idx] = yhat_test
    }
  }

  auc_perm = as.numeric(auc(y_true_num_cd, oof_prob_perm))
  baseline_auc_kernel_plsda_cd - auc_perm
}

set.seed(842)
cluster_cols_kernel_cd = cluster_cols_cd_logistic
imp_scores_kernel_plsda_cd = sapply(cluster_cols_cd_logistic, kernel_cd_perm_imp)
abs_imp = abs(imp_scores_kernel_plsda_cd)
imp_total_kernel_plsda_cd = abs_imp / sum(abs_imp) * 100

top_kernel_cd = names(sort(imp_total_kernel_plsda_cd, decreasing = T))[1:10]
direction_kernel_cd = sapply(top_kernel_cd, function(cl) {
  cor(X_cd[, cl], oof_prob_cd, use = "complete.obs")
})

# Extract confusion matrix
cm <- perf_kernel_plsda_cd$confusion_matrix
cm_result_splsda = confusionMatrix(cm) 
cm_table <- as.data.frame(cm_result_splsda$table)
colnames(cm_table) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")  # Fix names if needed
```

### Models 3,4 and 5: RF, XGB, SVC.
``` {r, message=F,warning=F} 

# RF for CD # 

cd_for_class_weighted_rf = cd_logistic[, c(cluster_cols_cd_logistic, "severity_bin")]
cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin = as.factor(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin)
levels(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin) = make.names(levels(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin))

# Compute class weights: up-weight minority class (severe) by 1.5 × imbalance ratio. 
weights_cd = table(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin)
class_weights_cd = c(1 / weights_cd[1], 1 / weights_cd[2])

# Prepare tuning grid with diverse values:
train_control = trainControl(method = "CV", number = 5, classProbs = T, summaryFunction = twoClassSummary)
tune_grid = expand.grid(mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(cd_for_class_weighted_rf) - 1)), splitrule = c("gini","extratrees"), min.node.size = c(1,3,5,10))

# Training setup, no class weights here.
set.seed(842)
rf_class_weighted_cd = train(severity_bin ~ .,
                              data = cd_for_class_weighted_rf,
                              method = "ranger",
                              trControl = train_control,
                              tuneGrid = tune_grid,
                              metric = "ROC",
                              importance = "permutation",
                              class.weights = NULL,
                              num.trees = 1000)

rf_best_auc = max(rf_class_weighted_cd$results$ROC)
rf_auc_cd = rf_best_auc

# Run RF with training, testing and cross-validation.
set.seed(842)
folds_rf_cd = shared_folds_cd
rf_prob_oof_cd = rep(NA_real_, nrow(cd_for_class_weighted_rf))

for (k in 1:5) {
  train_idx = which(folds_rf_cd != k)
  test_idx = which(folds_rf_cd == k)
  
  rf_fold = train(
                              severity_bin ~ .,
                              data = cd_for_class_weighted_rf[train_idx, ],
                              method = "ranger",
                              trControl = train_control,
                              tuneGrid = rf_class_weighted_cd$bestTune,
                              metric = "ROC",
                              importance = "permutation",
                              class.weights = NULL,
                              num.trees = 1000)
  
  prob_fold = predict(rf_fold,
                      newdata = cd_for_class_weighted_rf[test_idx, ],
                      type = "prob")[, 2]
  rf_prob_oof_cd[test_idx] = prob_fold
}

# Compute actual AUC.

})

# Compute calibration curve, slope, and intercept for RF
nbins <- 5
calib_df_rf <- data.frame(y = y_true_rf_cd, p = rf_prob_oof_cd)
calib_df_rf$bin <- cut(calib_df_rf$p,
                       breaks = quantile(calib_df_rf$p, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = nbins + 1), na.rm = TRUE),
                       include.lowest = TRUE)

calibration_curve_rf <- aggregate(cbind(p, y) ~ bin, data = calib_df_rf, FUN = mean)
names(calibration_curve_rf) <- c("bin", "mean_pred", "mean_obs")

# Fit linear regression for slope and intercept
calib_model_rf <- lm(mean_obs ~ mean_pred, data = calibration_curve_rf)
rf_calib_slope <- calib_model_rf$coefficients[2]
rf_calib_intercept <- calib_model_rf$coefficients[1]

plot(calibration_curve_rf$mean_pred, calibration_curve_rf$mean_obs,
     xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1),
     pch = 19, cex = 2, col = "black",
     xlab = "Mean Predicted Probability",
     ylab = "Observed Fraction (1)",
     main = "Random Forest Calibration Curve for CD cases")
abline(a = 0, b = 1, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
text(0.2, 0.9, paste("Slope:", round(rf_calib_slope, 3)), pos=4, cex=1.2)
text(0.2, 0.85, paste("Intercept:", round(rf_calib_intercept, 3)), pos=4, cex=1.2)

# Define parameter grid:
params_grid_xgb_cd = expand.grid(
  eta = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
  max_depth = c(3,6, 10),
  subsample = c(0.7, 0.8),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.7, 0.8)
)

# Define XGB with cross-validation.
xgb_cv_cd = lapply(seq_len(nrow(params_grid_xgb_cd)), function(i) {
  params = list(objective = "binary:logistic",
                eval_metric = c("logloss","auc"),
                scale_pos_weight = sum(y_cd_num == 0) / sum(y_cd_num == 1),
                eta = params_grid_xgb_cd$eta[i],
                max_depth = params_grid_xgb_cd$max_depth[i],
                subsample = params_grid_xgb_cd$subsample[i],
                colsample_bytree = params_grid_xgb_cd$colsample_bytree[i])

  xgb.cv(params = params,
         data =dtrain_cd,
         nrounds = 5,
         nfold = 5,
         early_stopping_rounds = 10,
         verbose = 0, maximize = T)
})

# Extract best log-loss and AUC from CV for each combination
best_iter_xgb_cd = sapply(xgb_cv_cd, function(x) x$best_iteration)
best_logloss_xgb_cd = sapply(xgb_cv_cd, function(x) min(x$evaluation_log$test_logloss_mean))

best_iter_num_xgb_cd = best_iter_xgb_cd[best_idx_xgb_cd]

final_params_xgb_cd = list(objective = "binary:logistic",
                           eval_metric = c("logloss", "auc"),
                           scale_pos_weight = sum(y_cd_num == 0) / sum(y_cd_num == 1),
                           eta = best_param_xgb_cd$eta,
                           max_depth = best_param_xgb_cd$max_depth,
                           subsample = best_param_xgb_cd$subsample,
                           colsample_bytree = best_param_xgb_cd$colsample_bytree)

# Final training

cd_for_class_weighted_rf = cd_logistic[, c(cluster_cols_cd_logistic, "severity_bin")]

levels(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin) = make.names(levels(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin))

# Define RBF-kernel SVC and train. Use pre-defined class weights for slightly better performance.
set.seed(842)
svm_tune_cd = tune(svm, severity_bin ~ ., data = cd_for_class_weighted_rf,
                   kernel = "radial",
                   ranges = list(cost = c(0.1, 1, 10), gamma = c(0.01, 0.1, 1)),
                   tunesize = 9,
                   cross = 5,
                   class.weights = class_weights_cd)

final_svm_cd = svm(severity_bin ~ ., data = cd_for_class_weighted_rf,
                   cost = svm_tune_cd$best.parameters$cost,
                   gamma = svm_tune_cd$best.parameters$gamma,
                   class.weights = class_weights_cd,
                   probability = T)

# Compute out-of-fold probabilities by running through different folds:
set.seed(842)
folds_cd = shared_folds_cd
oof_prob_cd_proper = rep(NA, nrow(cd_for_class_weighted_rf))

for (fold in 1:5) {
  train_idx = which(folds_cd != fold)
  test_idx = which(folds_cd == fold)
  
  svm_fold = svm(severity_bin ~., data = cd_for_class_weighted_rf[train_idx, ],
                 cost = svm_tune_cd$best.parameters$cost,
                   gamma = svm_tune_cd$best.parameters$gamma,
                   class.weights = class_weights_cd,
                   probability = T)
  
  pred_fold = predict(svm_fold, cd_for_class_weighted_rf[test_idx, ], probability = T)
  oof_prob_cd_proper[test_idx] = attr(pred_fold, "probabilities")[, "X1"]
                    
}

y_true_cd_num = as.numeric(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin == levels(cd_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin)[2])
baseline_auc_svc_cd = auc(y_true_cd_num, oof_prob_cd_proper)
roc_svc_cd = roc(y_true_cd_num, oof_prob_cd_proper)
svc_auc_ci_cd = ci.auc(roc_svc_cd, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = 2000)

# Run permutation importance:
perm_imp_svc_cd = function(col_idx) {
  data_perm = cd_for_class_weighted_rf
  data_perm[, col_idx] = sample(data_perm[, col_idx])
  pred_perm = predict(final_svm_cd, data_perm, probability = T)
  prob_perm = attr(pred_perm, "probabilities")[, "X1"]
  auc_perm = auc(y_true_cd_num, prob_perm)
  return(baseline_auc_svc_cd - auc_perm)
}

# Define the positive class explicitly (for consistency)
positive_class <- levels(uc_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin)[2]

for (fold in 1:5) {

    pred_fold = predict(svm_fold, uc_for_class_weighted_rf[test_idx, ], probability = T)

    oof_prob_uc_proper[test_idx] = prob_mat[, 2]
}

y_true_uc_num = as.numeric(uc_for_class_weighted_rf$severity_bin == positive_class)

# Permutation importance.
perm_imp_svc_uc = function(col_idx) {

  data_perm[, col_idx] = sample(data_perm[, col_idx])

total_importance = abs_imp_scores_svc_uc

imp_scores_total_svc_uc = total_importance / sum(total_importance) * 100

top_svc_uc = names(sort(imp_scores_total_svc_uc, decreasing = T))[1:10]
svc_direction_uc = sapply(top_svc_uc, function(cl) {
  cor(uc_for_class_weighted_rf[, cl], oof_prob_uc_proper, use = "complete.obs")
})

svc_pred_class_uc = ifelse(oof_prob_uc_proper >= 0.5, 1, 0)
svc_accuracy_uc = mean(svc_pred_class_uc == y_true_uc_num)
svc_brier_uc = mean((oof_prob_uc_proper - y_true_uc_num)^2)
svc_rmse_uc = sqrt(mean((oof_prob_uc_proper- y_true_uc_num)^2))

# Plot ROC
plot(roc_svc_uc,
     col = "black",
     lwd = 2,
     main = "Support Vector Classifier ROC - UC")
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "blue")
text(0.6, 0.1,
     labels = paste0("AUC = ", round(baseline_auc_svc_uc, 3)),
     col = "black")

# Create confusion matrix from OOF predictions
rf_cm_uc <- matrix(c(
    18, 24,   
    37, 24  
), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

rownames(rf_cm_uc) <- c("Predicted\nNon-Severe", "Predicted\nSevere")
colnames(rf_cm_uc) <- c("Actual\nSevere", "Actual\nNon-Severe")

cm_melt_uc <- melt(rf_cm_uc)
colnames(cm_melt_uc) <- c("Predicted", "Actual", "value")

cm_plot = ggplot(cm_melt_uc, aes(Actual, Predicted, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = value), size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#85416E", high = "#A5BC64") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),           # Keep tick labels
        axis.title = element_blank(),                                  # ← Remove titles
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none"
    )
cm_plot

# Compute calibration curve:
nbins <- 5
calib_df_svc <- data.frame(y = y_true_uc_num, p =oof_prob_uc_proper)
calib_df_svc$bin <- cut(calib_df_svc$p,
                       breaks = quantile(calib_df_svc$p, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = nbins + 1), na.rm = TRUE),
                       include.lowest = TRUE)

calibration_curve_svc <- aggregate(cbind(p, y) ~ bin, data = calib_df_svc, FUN = mean)
names(calibration_curve_svc) <- c("bin", "mean_pred", "mean_obs")

# Fit linear regression for slope and intercept
calib_model_svc <- lm(mean_obs ~ mean_pred, data = calibration_curve_svc)
svc_calib_slope <- calib_model_svc$coefficients[2]
svc_calib_intercept <- calib_model_svc$coefficients[1]

plot(calibration_curve_svc$mean_pred, calibration_curve_svc$mean_obs,
     xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1),
     pch = 19, cex = 2, col = "black",
     xlab = "Mean Predicted Probability",
     ylab = "Observed Fraction (1)",
     main = "SVC Calibration Curve for UC Cases")
abline(a = 0, b = 1, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
text(0.2, 0.9, paste("Slope:", round(svc_calib_slope, 3)), pos=4, cex=1.2)
text(0.2, 0.85, paste("Intercept:", round(svc_calib_intercept, 3)), pos=4, cex=1.2)
lines(lowess(calibration_curve_svc$mean_pred, calibration_curve_svc$mean_obs),
      col = "blue", lwd = 2)
```

``` {r, message=F,warning=F} 
# Prepare laboratory data for CD:
lab_crp_calpro_cd = fread(here("data", "lab_for_cezar.csv")) %>%
    filter(diagnosis_phase == "AroundDiagnosis2Y") %>%
    filter(!is.na(protein)) %>%
    filter(lbnr %in% cd_severity_metadata$lbnr) %>%
    dplyr::select(1,4,5) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = lbnr, names_from = protein, values_from = lab_measure_value) %>%
  mutate(lbnr = as.character(lbnr))

crp_fcal_clusters_cd <- inner_join(lab_crp_calpro_cd,  # Your lab df
                          raw6_severity %>% dplyr::select(lbnr, starts_with("Cluster_")),  # Your cluster df
                          by = "lbnr") %>%
    dplyr::select(-lbnr)  # Drop ID for cor matrix

# Spearman correlations between clusters and CRP + Fcal.
cluster_vars_cd <- grep("Cluster_", colnames(crp_fcal_clusters_cd), value = TRUE)
cor_results_cd <- cor(crp_fcal_clusters_cd[, c("crp", "Fcal", cluster_vars_cd)], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

biomarkers = c("crp","Fcal")
# With p-values
p_mat_cd <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(biomarkers), ncol = length(cluster_vars_cd),
                dimnames = list(biomarkers, cluster_vars_cd))

for (biomarker in biomarkers) {
    for (cl in cluster_vars_cd) {
        test <- cor.test(crp_fcal_clusters_cd[[biomarker]], crp_fcal_clusters_cd[[cl]],
                         method = "spearman")
        p_mat_cd[biomarker, cl] <- test$p.value
    }
}

p_adj_cd <- p_mat_cd
p_adj_cd["crp", ] <- p.adjust(p_mat_cd["crp", ], method = "fdr")
p_adj_cd["Fcal", ] <- p.adjust(p_mat_cd["Fcal", ], method = "fdr")

# Adjust p-values per marker and clean results.
p_adj_df_cd <- p_adj_cd %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    pivot_longer(-variable, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "p_adj")

cor_tidy_cd <- cor_results_cd %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    pivot_longer(-variable, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "rho") %>%
    filter(variable %in% c("crp", "Fcal"))

p_tidy_cd <- p_mat_cd %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("biomarker") %>%
    pivot_longer(-biomarker, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "p_value") %>%
    rename(variable = biomarker)

final_results_cd <- cor_tidy_cd %>%
    left_join(p_tidy_cd, by = c("variable", "cluster")) %>%
    left_join(p_adj_df_cd, by = c("variable", "cluster")) %>%
    arrange(variable, p_adj)
```
